arguments.description: Inspect main repo and worktree state
arguments.command: Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Name; Write-Host "--- git log ---"; git log --oneline -5; Write-Host "--- status ---"; git status --short; Write-Host "--- files ---"; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Exclude .git | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\.git\\' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring((Get-Location).Path.Length+1) }
